components.text:
Precision Fluid Pipette is a focused tool for handling fluids with the precision a bucket can't offer.

Where a bucket forces you to deal in fixed 1000 mB increments, the pipette stores any amount from 1 mB up to 1000 mB..

Its makes it perfect for topping up tanks, draining the last few drops out of a machine, or moving partial amounts between systems without spilling or wasting anything.

It's a manual tool — no automation, no pipes, no networks. Just one well-behaved item that does five things well.
